title: Restore the reading position after browser Back
steps: Scroll down Morgan Reed's Replies stream to load additional replies, then pause at Route note 05 in Weekend walking plans 01.
Open the topic using the title link beside Route note 05.
Use browser Back and inspect the returned Replies stream.
